summary: Extended the session protocol with event roles, a queue snapshot, and a compaction result event (bumping protocolVersion to 28), then wired the agent-server to translate Pi queue_update/compaction_end events, emit queue and compaction-result snapshots, append compaction rows to the session transcript, and run an overdue-threshold compaction fallback.
decisions: Protocol version bumped from 27 to 28 to carry the new event role, queue snapshot, and compaction result shapes.
Pi event translator was split so its pure helpers live in a separate file, keeping the main translator under the project's file-length policy.

Pi's whole-turn threshold compaction is paired with an explicit compaction-fallback that re-invokes compact() when the context is past the threshold, restoring the user's previously configured policy afterwards.
Compaction entries become first-class rows in the session transcript, with messages between firstKeptEntryId and the new head folded into the summary rather than dropped.
Queue state is exposed to the client as a single queue snapshot event per session change rather than streamed incrementally.
errors: An inline Python heredoc used to patch session-transcript.ts and session-runtime-pool.ts failed with "unexpected EOF while looking for matching `''`"; the work was recovered by moving the script to .gizmo-dev/patch1.py and re-running it.
`pnpm --filter @gizmo/protocol build` printed ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_RUN_NO_SCRIPT because the protocol package exposes no build script; the agent-server `tsc` check that followed still completed.
